messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a base-image rebuild this week to pick up distro CVE patches, migrate to distroless-slim, and rotate the KMS envelope key used for image signing. Need to coordinate RBAC changes for the image-signer/deploy service accounts and attach audit logging for image provenance. Who's available for a quick sync? cc @sam @jessie

sam: I can do Wed morning. For RBAC we'll need explicit KMS Encrypt/Decrypt for the image-signer SA and storage.objectViewer for canary nodes. Also might want short-lived bindings (time-bound) rather than permanent roles. Can you list exact resources (key ring, buckets)?

jessie: Agree with minimal perms. Example IAM snippets we plan to propose:
```
- serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
- serviceAccount:deploy-runner@redwood: roles/storage.objectViewer
```
Also: prefer using conditions on the KMS binding (src.ip_range or time window) where possible. Avoid long-lived DECRYPT access for non-ci actors.

anand: Audit logging note — we should add an image-pull provenance sink and require artifact registry attestations. CI must attach SBOM + signature (grafeas note). I'll provision a sec-audit log bucket and a restricted writer principal for the pipeline.

ci-bot: CI job 'image:build-and-sign' succeeded on commit 3f2b9a. SBOM: https://sbom.internal/3f2b9a | sig: gs://signatures/3f2b9a.sig :white_check_mark:

maria: Rollout plan proposal: canary 5% across Dedicated-GPU pool -> 50% internal-prod for 24h. If any vuln regression or latency > baseline +5% we auto-rollback. KMS key rotation should happen after canary passes (windowed, off-peak). Also need to sync with on-prem teams for private deployments.

sam: Quick question — do we need to rebuild node AMIs / base images for private/on-prem? That can add time for air-gapped sites. Ops: what migration window do we have?

jessie: Yes on-prem gets the same signed images. We'll publish an image-manifest.json with signature and SBOM and provide a verify-image.sh script for operators. Example usage:
```
./verify-image.sh --image gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-04-01 --sig gs://signatures/3f2b9a.sig --sbom https://sbom.internal/3f2b9a
```
Gate the deploy pipeline for any env that can't run verification.

anand: Vulnerability triage: patched CVE is glibc subpackage — low exploitability in our runtime paths but high CVSS score. Marked P2, added regression test in eval harness. Validated on canary images, no perf regression observed on our latency microbenchmarks.

maria: Plan confirmed. Sync Wed 09:30 UTC (15m). Deploy candidate Wed 14:00 UTC canary. If canary is clean, rotate KMS key Thu 02:00 UTC (maintenance window). I'll open a release ticket and update the runtime rebuild runbook with the RBAC + audit steps. @jessie can you add verify-image steps & retention increase to the runbook? :thumbsup:

jessie: On it — I'll add RBAC snippets, the verify script, and temporarily bump audit retention to 72h to help forensics if anything weird shows up.

sam: I'll draft the IAM PR with time-bound conditions and link here when ready.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll DM invites for Wed sync and attach the release checklist. Keeping the thread for the runbook links and PRs.
